Replaced the plugin-marketplace command with a config.toml [mcp_servers.context-mode] entry, with a worked example block and an update note (re-run checkout + rewrite entry, no plugin.json version bump for Codex).

Added rows for Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot, Kiro and ZCode with each agent's own install mechanism, all flagged [O] (not yet tested live), per spike-distribution.md.
Narrowed 'no skills' to 'no feature skills beyond /ctx-stats, /ctx-doctor, /ctx-upgrade', pointing at §9 where the 3 command skills are named.
Added a [D] line: DeepSeek Harness (#1258) and Devin CLI (#957) are deferred past v2.0 GA per D14 (new-adapter requests, no prior code history), instead of silently omitting them.
